headline: What to Expect During a Multi-Room Remodel
articleBody:
Considering a multi-room remodel in your Berkeley or East Bay home? It's a big undertaking, and knowing what to expect can really help manage the process. Often, folks wonder about the scope, budget, and how long it’ll all take. The timeline really depends on factors like how big the project is, what kind of permits are needed, and if any hidden issues pop up, like old wiring or structural stuff. It’s not uncommon for things to get extended if inspections don't pass the first time around.

Then there's the question of living in your home during the remodel. Depending on which rooms are being tackled, and the sequence, you might be able to stay put, or you might need to make temporary arrangements. We do everything from plumbing and electrical to cabinet installation and painting for a complete remodel, so there will be various trades coming through your home.

Disruptions are part of the process, but good communication with your contractor can make a huge difference. You'll want to get an itemized estimate upfront, detailing allowances and how change orders will be handled, so there are no surprises. Being prepared for these aspects makes the whole experience much smoother. If you’re ready to talk through the specifics for your home, reach out to us at Frasheski Construction.
